findings.quote: When the Romans were already close at hand, they gave the signal for battle and put out to sea, having resolved to fight.
findings.problem: The genitive absolute ἤδη δὲ καὶ τῶν Ῥωμαίων σύνεγγυς ὄντων leaves the subject of σημήναντες ... ἀνήγοντο, κρίναντες ναυμαχεῖν as Hasdrubal's men (οἱ περὶ τὸν Ἀσδρούβαν), i.e. the Carthaginians. The English 'they' after 'the Romans' reads as the Romans putting out, and the following 'before long they began to give way' (πρὸς τὸ κλίνειν ὥρμησαν) is the Carthaginians, so the identity of the subject is inverted.
findings.proposed_fix: When the Romans were already close at hand, the Carthaginians gave the signal for battle and put out to sea, having resolved to fight.
